new_hypothesis.name: bonding_curve_velocity_pregrad_snipe
new_hypothesis.mechanism: On pump.fun/letsBONK, the single strongest predictor of graduation (and the price pop that follows the $69K Raydium/PumpSwap migration) is LIQUIDITY VELOCITY - how few swaps it takes to reach a given vSol level. Fast accumulation in <=10-50 trades = distributed real conviction that mechanically drives the curve to migration, which itself triggers a fresh DEX-listing buy wave. Entering when velocity crosses a high band puts the bot IN before the migration crowd (median time-to-graduation ~4.4 min).
new_hypothesis.persistence: It requires real-time on-chain swap-SEQUENCE parsing of bonding-curve accounts (Geyser/RPC or Bitquery), not price polling. DexScreener/GeckoTerminal only surface a token reliably AFTER it graduates and a DEX pool exists, so any price-polling bot is structurally minutes late. <1 in 200 of ~30k daily launches graduate, so the noise floor deters lazy competitors and the edge is not crowded out by other DexScreener bots.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Extend the EXISTING pump.fun+letsBONK graduation websocket logger from an after-the-fact event recorder into a pre-graduation velocity scorer: per live bonding-curve token compute trades-to-vSol velocity + buyer-wallet diversity; flag candidates that reach the vSol threshold in <=~10-50 real (non-sub-2s-wash) trades AND have >=N distinct aged buyer wallets. Phase 1 = LOG-ONLY (record velocity score + forward 10/30-min return for every flagged candidate) to calibrate the threshold before any live entry.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Direct RPC/Geyser subscription to the pump.fun bonding-curve program accounts (or Bitquery pump.fun bonding-curve API) to read curve PROGRESS + per-token swap-count velocity in real time. The existing graduation listener already touches this program - this extends it to read progress/velocity, not just the terminal graduation event. NOT DexScreener.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Peer-reviewed study arXiv 2602.14860 ('Predicting the success of new crypto-tokens: the Pump.fun case') finds liquidity velocity dominates ALL other variables as a graduation predictor; effect is monotonic and survives filtering sub-2s wash trades. Median time-to-graduation ~4.4 min. Launchpad context (late May 2026): pump.fun has REGAINED ~70-80% of launches and ~95% of graduations after the 2025 letsBONK coup reversed (The Block, Decrypt), so the bot's pump.fun-first coverage is correctly weighted and this edge fires most where the logger already listens. Of ~30k daily launches ~150 graduate; a conservative velocity+diversity filter likely yields 15-40 actionable candidates/day.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: The ONLY clean separator of the catastrophic calm-entry WC loss (SQUIRE -14.07% EMERGENCY) from the flat-wins is the live order book on an AGED token. SQUIRE-LOSS: pair_age 1718h, gt_buyers_m5=0 < gt_sellers_m5=2 (net-SELL dead/distribution tape). SQUIRE-WIN (SAME mint, 3d earlier): age 1656h but gt_buyers_m5=10 > gt_sellers_m5=2 (net-BUY). TROLL win: age 9676h but net-buy 5>3. So neither age alone nor net-sell alone works (each kills a win); the COMBO blocks exactly SQUIRE-LOSS and zero wins.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: wallet_convergence all_time N=15, WR 53.3%, R/R 0.35, pnl -0.005885 SOL; rolling_7d N=4 WR 75% R/R 0.08 pnl -0.004349 (the single 7d loss IS SQUIRE -14.07%, which alone is -0.004512 SOL = larger than the whole 7d pnl). 7 lifetime losses: Goblin -8.1, Bumpy -13.43, soothsayer -13.08, CWU -0.24, ASTEROID -12.5, TOLYBOT -8.21, SQUIRE-L -14.07.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Removes the single largest WC loss class (aged-token distribution dump). On the current 15-trade sample, blocking SQUIRE-LOSS lifts WC all-time pnl from -0.005885 to -0.001373 SOL and R/R from 0.35 toward ~0.55, with ZERO wins lost. The CWC veto (run-300) already handles the 3 hot-5m losses (Bumpy/soothsayer/ASTEROID); this gate handles the calm aged-dump that CWC misses.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Revert if, after activation, the gate blocks >=2 entries that (counterfactually, via logged would-have features) would have been WINS, OR if WC rolling-10-trade R/R falls below 0.30 with the gate live.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: Evaluate at N=8 WC fires post-activation (WC fires only ~2-4x/wk, so ~3-4 weeks). The gate is near-zero-cost on wins so it can ship before N is large.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY (the aged-distribution mechanism is regime-independent; observed in CHOP/ALTCOIN_WINTER).
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Remove the two-condition WC entry skip (pair_age_hours>=1700 AND gt_sellers_m5>gt_buyers_m5); revert to CWC-veto-only WC entry logic.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Worst case it silently blocks a rare aged-token WC win. At N=15 it blocks 0 historical wins, and WC win contribution from aged net-sell-book tokens is empirically zero, so expected foregone profit is ~0; the realistic downside is just one missed marginal flat-win (~+0.5%) every few weeks.
proposals_for_survival_brain.anti_stacking_note: This stacks on TWO already-shipped-but-not-yet-activated WC changes (CWC veto + source_wallet logging, both pre-activation since the bot has not restarted since 2026-05-28).
